about: These are the paths workflow tools read and write in a workspace, so their names are fixed. A workspace may add to them and records each deviation in the Local rules section of AGENTS.md.

entries.used_by: data adapters resolve dataset locations here
research notes keep each functional block's theory here
baseline code and data adapters live here
the dispatcher reads experiment configs here
accepted run records are kept with each batch
meeting records are kept by date here
decks live here, one folder each
working state stays outside version control
workspace instructions and Local rules are read here
decisions about this workspace are recorded here
